cross_cutting_conditions: HPO may tune only registered nonstructural candidate values; structures reviewed here remain fixed.
The TSMixer.9 sourcepoint is physically supported and tested after explicit API-domain amendment; only hashed registry may admit that exceptional sourcepoint to the HPO run.
Every actually imported author dependency and numeric preset must be included in the execution author_sources hash manifest, not only the primary Model.py file.

No blanket source-DOI exemption: these ten individual structures are defined by reviewed source code, presets and necessary D7 task changes. Any unreviewed structure change requires amendment and new review.
The inherited three E1 anchors remain fixed references; their E2 retuned variants keep inherited defined structures with separate nonstructural optimization.
TimesNet linear Inception fusion is output/gradient equivalent with all original kernels retained; runtime/FLOP comparisons concern this implementation, not intrinsic model-family superiority.
S-Mamba uses genuine input-dependent bidirectional variable selective scans and matches pinned reference outputs/gradients; CPU nonfused runtime and unsupported FLOP operations must be disclosed.
TiDE temporal output latent8 uses the source decoder width to avoid LayerNorm1 collapse; this changed task head is not an exact original scalar forecast or a new architecture search.

This architectural review does not certify full pipeline leakage checks, small-batch optimization sanity, actual HPO completion, power, calibration, literature eligibility, final superiority or a new unseen test.
